title: THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
text:
BUSINESS MEETING OF SAVOY COLLEGE EX-STUDENTS IN REUNION AT SAVOY, TEXAS, AUGUST 6, 1938

The meeting was called to order by the general chairman, E. A. McMahon, at 2 p.m. in the auditorium, Halsell Gymnasium, Savoy. Prayer was offered by the Reverend Matt Harder of Ralls. The address of welcome by Hon. J. B. May was that of acceptance, followed by a response by Judge G. F. Webb, of Sherman.

Reports of various committees were read and approved.

Judge Webb submitted resolutions providing for a permanent organization, which were adopted unanimously. The name of the organization shall be "The Savoy College Ex-Student Association," of which every ex-student is automatically a member, without dues, and dues never to be assessed.

Judge Webb, Sam McKee, and Mrs. S. H. Montgomery were appointed as a committee to select a slate of officers. Their recommendations were voted upon as a whole and all were elected. The slate thus unanimously elected to the permanent organization:

E. A. McMahon, Dallas, President
John M. Gid, Oneco, Vice-President
Mrs. J. B. May, Savoy, Secretary
Mrs. Gus Thomasson, Dallas, Historian
Board of Managers:
    Gus W. Thomasson, Dallas
    G. F. Webb, Sherman
    L. J. Reynolds, Arlington

October 15, 1938, was suggested and accepted, as Savoy College Day at the Dallas Fair.

Following the business session, a brief paper on the history of the College was read by Mrs. Pamela Boyd, the historian; a "commencement" song was given, a reading by Mrs. W. L. Young; and a short talk by Tom Webb concluded the program.

The meeting adjourned for the banquet at 8 p.m.

Mrs. J. B. May, Secretary
E. A. McMahon, President
